plex_url.description: Plex server URL, for example http://192.168.1.50:32400

recently_added_movies_limit.description: Maximum number of newest movies included in the Recently Added rotation pool. Set to 0 to exclude movies from Recently Added only.

recently_added_tv_limit.description: Maximum number of newest TV items included in the Recently Added rotation pool. Set to 0 to exclude TV from Recently Added only.

recently_added_music_limit.description: Maximum number of newest music items included in the Recently Added rotation pool. Set to 0 to exclude music from Recently Added only.

layout.description: Auto selects the ultra-wide marquee layout on very wide displays such as 320x32

artwork_width.description: Artwork tile width in pixels for marquee layout

accent_width.description: Width of the Plex-gold accent divider

show_panel_dividers.description: Draw subtle vertical guides at physical panel boundaries

panel_width.description: Physical panel width used for optional divider guides

recent_count.description: General item limit used for Recently Played and library queries

live_priority.description: Allow active Plex playback to advertise live content priority when supported by LEDMatrix
